design: Gather checked crypto roots and producer branches before the shared graph stage; retain them and graph roots within the existing 2 GiB allowance.
Schedule matching leaf and parent positions across up to four graphs through one exact-identity GPU preprocessing cache.
Compile and lower parents in the existing weighted CPU window; retire child proofs before lowering and release the preparation permit before GPU execution.
Keep proof counts, fan-in, native group widths, cryptographic relations, security parameters, and GPU kernels unchanged.
scope_limits: One matched measurement per revision on this GPU; no confidence interval or complete N4 workflow speedup is claimed.
The comparison repeats one archived eight-leaf N4 subtree twice, generating and verifying 18 fresh recursive proofs; it is not two distinct transactions.
Full-workflow transaction batching uses the same scheduler and builds successfully, but no new complete N3/N4 workflow was run.
Parent lowering moved from setup_seconds into template_preparation_seconds; compare total completion time, not setup alone.
Per-graph latencies overlap in the new pipeline and must not be summed.
